coupling_analysis.MongoDB sharing: Not a coupling issue — independent collections (logs_col vs traffic_logs_col vs reports_col)
coupling_analysis.Code imports: Zero direct imports — can study independently
coupling_analysis.Operational coupling: Sequential flow (traffic → detector → agent → reports) but can be studied separately
coupling_analysis.Shared concepts: Both use Pydantic (BaseModel), both use MongoDB, both parse timestamps — good interview topics

why_this_split: Minimal cross-dependencies: no imports between files, independent MongoDB collections
Clear topic boundaries: one is ML/feature engineering, one is LLM/reasoning
Balanced complexity: 260 LOC (ML) vs 309 LOC (agent) — roughly equal
Defense readiness: each person can deeply own their half — ML engineer owns detector, security engineer owns threat-hunting
Architectural clarity: detector is stateless inference, agent is stateful reasoning — different concerns
Interview narrative: detector tells 'how do you build fast ML for IDS?', agent tells 'how do you reason about threats with LLM?'
